    Functionals on Π(Δ) modulo deleted vertices #

    Tools for the nonvanishing statements of Appendix A (periodic-mesh-calculations.tex: "Assigning these values in k gives a nonzero functional annihilating all the relations"). A function g on vertex lists gives a functional on paths (vfun); it annihilates the ideal of Π(Δ) modulo the deleted vertices when its values on the terms of each contextual relation cancel and it vanishes on lists through deleted vertices (vfun_eq_zero_of_mem). The constant term (len0) shows that the vertex idempotents of retained vertices are nonzero.
